It seems a poacher managed to get into the {wiki:Formorgar Mines} but did not make it out alive. Follow the path from Svargrond to the mines, go down the stairs and open the chest in the corner to receive a {item:Lion Trophy}, a {item:Shard} and 2 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}.
It seems a poacher found the way into the mines, but did not make it out alive.
Stairs at the end of the path to the Formorgar Mines
Having reached the mission "Formorgar Mines 1" of {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest}.
The {spell:Levitate} spell (or equivalent) to go up on the path west of Svargrond.
On the way and in the mines there are {creature:Mammoth|Mammoths}, {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems}, {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems} and {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns}: bring enough potions.

If you are not in **Svargrond** yet, take a boat there (for example in Carlin or with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais): talk to the port captain and say {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}. You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the **east** part of the city.
In the city of **Svargrond**, go **west**, use {spell:Levitate} to go up and follow the path towards the {wiki:Formorgar Mines}, as on the map.
Path from Svargrond to the Formorgar Mines

At the end of the path, go down these stairs to enter the {wiki:Formorgar Mines}, beneath the {wiki:Formorgar Glacier}. You can only enter if you have already reached the mission "Formorgar Mines 1" of {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest}.
The stairs at the end of the path
The rewards are in the {item:Chest (Quest)|chest} in the corner, **east** of the stairs.
The chest in the corner east of the stairs

To leave, go back the same way: return to the stairs you came down and climb them. Then follow the path on the map in reverse to **Svargrond**, using {spell:Levitate} again (this time downwards) at the spot where you went up. In Svargrond, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you back by boat.
Follow this path in reverse to return to Svargrond
